topic: How does the 11.6% bandwidth of the CTS antenna influence frequency planning and spectral efficiency for broadband satellite links?
consensus_response: The 11.6% bandwidth of the CTS antenna significantly influences frequency planning and spectral efficiency by limiting usable spectrum, increasing interference, and intermodulation distortion. Advanced techniques like beamforming, MIMO, and adaptive coding mitigate these effects, optimizing signal-to-interference ratio and enhancing system performance.
reference_context: CTS antennas offer attractive solutions for next-generation satellite communication terminals with improved axial ratio and reflection coefficient over relative bandwidths.
